nodes.title: What is generative AI
nodes.one_liner: Generative AI is a kind of artificial intelligence that creates new content — text, images, audio, video, or software code — instead of only sorting or labeling content that already exists.
questions: How exactly does a *prompt* steer the output? (Leads toward prompting lessons.)

How is Claude specifically built and adapted?

nodes.title: claude.ai (web app)
nodes.one_liner: claude.ai is Anthropic's consumer chat app for Claude — a website (with matching mobile and desktop apps) where you get things done just by *talking* to Claude in plain language, no coding required.

nodes.title: Claude Desktop app
nodes.one_liner: The Claude Desktop app is a native, downloadable program that puts Claude directly on your Mac or Windows computer (with Linux still in beta), instead of only inside a web browser tab.
questions: What exactly is an MCP server, and what tools can I connect? (see MCP servers)

nodes.title: Prompting basics
nodes.one_liner: A prompt is the plain-language text you type to Claude that tells it *what to do, how to do it, and what kind of response you expect*.
questions: How exactly do I *structure* a longer prompt, and how do I add examples? → Prompt structure & examples

nodes.title: System prompts
nodes.one_liner: A system prompt is a set of standing instructions you give Claude — its role, goal, tone, and rules — that sits *separate from* your actual question and shapes how Claude answers everything that follows.
questions: How long/detailed should a system prompt be for a complex task?

nodes.title: Projects
nodes.one_liner: A Claude Project is a self-contained workspace on claude.ai that bundles a set of chats, a shared knowledge base, and custom instructions all focused on a single goal.
questions: How exactly do I write good custom instructions? (See System prompts.)

nodes.title: MCP servers
nodes.one_liner: An MCP server is a small program that plugs an outside tool or source of information (like your files, a calendar, or a website's data) into Claude, so Claude can actually use it.
questions: Where do I find trustworthy MCP servers to connect?

nodes.title: Safety & limits
nodes.one_liner: "Safety & limits" means knowing the ways Claude can be wrong or fall short — and the simple habits (checking its facts, protecting your private information, keeping a human in charge) that keep you safe while using it.
